Clarification transport. Preserve Store.history reviewer exclusion of worker prose and firstmate briefs, and its exact ASK-PASS-CRITERIA marker-only transport. A genuine operator ASK is author firstmate, never fabricated worker/reviewer evidence. Do not add arbitrary prose, mutable prompt injection, vendor launch arguments or broad private paths. Existing stock review must emit a fixed instruction when the delivered ASK marker requests clarification, for every eligible round including round2/3+. Correct fm-review current if round>=2 / elif round>=3 unreachable branch. First-round ordinary reviews remain unchanged.

Reviewer contract. When ASK-PASS-CRITERIA is delivered, independently reissue the complete contiguous numbered standing list, preserving every prior numbered item and transparent associations, mark each done/open with factual evidence, and close it with CRITERIA-COMPLETE before any truthful verdict. Explicitly explain this ASK exception to the ordinary rule that APPROVE need not reissue a list. Do not require APPROVE, require technical changes without findings, invent same-head regressions/new ground or renumber away open findings. Ordinary no-ASK APPROVE remains legal.

Approval clearing contract. Use the existing protocol parser and signed verifier unchanged. An actual authenticated new APPROVE with complete original done items and closing marker may clear the prior syntax error through existing current-items logic; an APPROVE without that block must not silently waive the old syntax failure. No clearing old record, dropping findings, fabricating markers, treating firstmate questions as verdicts or modifying parser/signatures/eligibility.

Migration and truth. Preserve every historical signed and unsealed legacy record byte-for-byte, existing pins/spec/design/contract hashes, and existing review source-binding/provenance authority. Existing running frozen snapshots keep their original instruction; only new stock launches from amended verified code receive the fixed ASK clarification. No automatic pin rewrite or old verdict mutation. Ordinary initially approved tasks with no standing list and valid REJECT followed by ordinary no-ASK APPROVE remain compatible. New instruction applies only when an actual ASK marker is delivered, including existing tasks newly reviewed. Unsealed legacy can remain readable history but is not newly promoted to authenticated gate authority. Add before/after full-byte comparisons for signed and unsealed history, unchanged pins, initially approved/valid ordinary-approval migration matrices. Syntax does not prove semantic finding closure.
